description:
About the Scholarship

Central European University (CEU) in Vienna awards one of Europe's most transparent financial-aid packages: doctoral students receive a stipend of €2,002 gross per month for up to 48 months, while master's and bachelor's applicants are automatically considered for awards ranging from partial tuition relief to full tuition plus living support.

OpportunityCEU Student Scholarships / Financial Aid
HostCentral European University
LocationVienna, Austria
Study LevelBachelor's, Master's, PhD
FundingFully Funded (doctoral) / up to full tuition (master's)
StipendDoctoral Stipend €2,002 gross/month for up to 48 months; master's awards up to full tuition plus living support
Application DeadlineBachelor's & Master's: 15 Oct 2026 (Round 1) / 2 Feb 2027 (Round 2); PhD: 15 Jan 2027
ApplyOfficial financial-aid page ↗

Central European University (CEU) in Vienna awards one of Europe's most transparent financial-aid packages: doctoral students receive a stipend of €2,002 gross per month for up to 48 months, while master's and bachelor's applicants are automatically considered for awards ranging from partial tuition relief to full tuition plus living support.

Programme Highlights

  • Doctoral Stipend: €2,002 gross per month, awarded for up to 48 months
  • Automatic consideration — one admission application covers financial aid (no separate scholarship form for most awards)
  • Master's packages range from partial tuition relief to full tuition plus monthly living support
  • Two admission rounds for bachelor's/master's (15 October and 2 February) and a single doctoral deadline (15 January)

Who Should Apply

Applicants to any CEU degree programme. Financial aid is awarded on academic merit and need as assessed in the admission file; doctoral offers come with the standard doctoral stipend package unless a different arrangement is stated.

Funding and Costs

Doctoral funding is the standout: €2,002 gross/month for four years is above most European PhD stipends after tax (Austrian income tax applies). Master's awards vary by department and year — the strongest files in Round 1 get the best packages, and later rounds award what remains.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit your programme application (with transcripts, CV, statement of purpose, letters of recommendation) by your round's deadline — financial aid consideration is automatic. Doctoral applicants should also contact prospective supervisors before applying, as CEU admissions are supervisor-linked in many departments. Key deadline information: PhD 15 January 2027; bachelor's & master's Round 1 15 October 2026, Round 2 2 February 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Central European University (CEU)

Central European University is a US- and Austrian-accredited graduate research university headquartered in Vienna, known for its generous financial aid: doctoral students receive a multi-year stipend and most master's applicants are automatically considered for tuition awards.

Official website: https://www.ceu.edu

Contact

Questions about this scholarship, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official scholarship page (see the Official Link section above). Always include your applicant ID or programme name so the admissions or scholarship team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements and deadlines on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form — transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
  • Deadlines shown in local time (CET/CEST) as published by the provider; convert to your own time zone before planning.
